description: This file contains session management functions for the Revive Adserver, including session fetching, setting cookies, starting, regenerating, clearing, storing, destroying sessions, and token handling.

methods.name: phpAds_SessionDataFetch
methods.description: Fetches session data from the database using session ID from cookies.

methods.name: phpAds_SessionSetAdminCookie
methods.description: Sets an admin cookie with specified name and value, considering domain and SSL requirements.

methods.name: phpAds_SessionStart
methods.description: Starts a new session if no session ID exists in cookies.

methods.name: phpAds_SessionGenerateId
methods.description: Generates a new session ID and sets it in a cookie.

methods.name: phpAds_SessionRegenerateId
methods.description: Regenerates session ID, optionally deleting all user sessions.

methods.name: phpAds_clearSession
methods.description: Clears the current session and marks it as authentic.

methods.name: phpAds_SessionDataRegister
methods.description: Registers data into the session array.

methods.name: phpAds_SessionDataStore
methods.description: Stores the session data in the database.

methods.name: phpAds_SessionDataDestroy
methods.description: Destroys the current session and deletes session data.

methods.name: phpAds_SessionGetToken
methods.description: Retrieves or generates a session token.

methods.name: phpAds_SessionValidateToken
methods.description: Validates a session token against the stored token.
